context: Reference focused cleanup: multi-operation stream chains should be wrapped for readability without semantic changes.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Returns complete Java 17-compatible StreamFormattingSample code with imports, methods, and records intact.

checklist.name: Wraps multi-operation chains
checklist.description: Moves each operation after stream() to its own continuation line for chains with more than one operation after the source stream call.

checklist.name: Keeps stream on source line
checklist.description: Keeps .stream() attached to the source expression rather than moving it to a separate line.

checklist.name: Handles single-operation chain proportionately
checklist.description: Leaves the one-operation labels.stream().findFirst() chain on one line or wraps it coherently; does not apply unrelated API churn or move .stream() onto a standalone line just to satisfy the multi-operation wrapping rule.

checklist.name: Preserves stream behavior
checklist.description: Does not change terminal operations, collectors, mapping behavior, encounter order, fallback value, or map keys while formatting.

checklist.name: Avoids style-only API churn
checklist.description: Does not introduce different collectors, helper methods, parallel streams, or unrelated imports while making a formatting-only change.

metadata.reference_selection: Focused issue #45 coverage for readable multi-operation stream-chain wrapping.
